REASON: The reviewer correctly identifies the fatal flaw that the cron schedule `0 6 31 * *` will fail to run in five months of the year and treats it as a critical issue that must be fixed. The reviewer recommends fixing and revising the proposal rather than abandoning it entirely, so it is blocked but not killed.
FLAW_CAUGHT: 1
KILLED: 0
BLOCKED: 1
